theme: a fern-carpeted forest floor between giant trunks, jade fireflies, half-buried grafting ruins

landmarks.name: Fernreach Camp
landmarks.note: Arrival from Sylvara's East Gate; the scout gives field tips.

landmarks.name: Fernreach Crossing
landmarks.note: Four paths meet under the pylon.

landmarks.name: Fern Hollow
landmarks.note: Passive Graftling herds in tall ferns.

landmarks.name: Sap Grove
landmarks.note: Tapped trunks; Graftlings root round the taps.

landmarks.name: Glimmer Run
landmarks.note: Stream and pond; Graftlings wander the banks.

landmarks.name: Grafted Ruins
landmarks.note: An Aethrion grafting yard; the first Graftlings were bolted together here.
